facts.fact: 生命从 logo 开始：黑白水塔/弦乐/timpani；你叫 Wilhelm，曾是男人
facts.anchor: A black-and-white water tower illuminates stars in a black-and-white sky.

facts.fact: 事故→变成怪物→被村民火烧→less than ninety minutes 一生结束
facts.anchor: The whole thing took a lifetime. And yet it was over in less than ninety minutes.

facts.fact: 童年记忆模糊；初恋 Marcela 在 Harvard Square 河边野餐（芥末籽滴到裙上）
facts.anchor: Mustard seed dripping from her chin down to her summer dress.

facts.fact: Marcela 父亲最后通牒：放弃研究或禁止婚事
facts.anchor: Either give up your research and return to Cambridge, or he would forbid a union between you and his daughter.

facts.fact: 记忆分叉：黑白版=滑倒；彩色版=收音机声音『Find a screen, Wilhelm』导致滑倒
facts.anchor: “Find a screen,” it said. “Find a screen, Wilhelm.”

facts.fact: 蝙蝠咬伤感染→变成半人半蝙蝠 Chimotera、杀死 Marcela 父亲、撕碎 Marcela、被烧死
facts.anchor: You were horrific. A monster. No longer Wilhelm.

facts.fact: 彩色复醒：空村、收音机合唱 Find a screen、Grand Paramount 电影院空场
facts.anchor: There’s that voice again. The voice that beamed through the radio from a deeper, more vivid reality.

facts.fact: 银幕上出现 RadioShack 副总裁 Fisch（无声片+title cards）；给『免费样品』重启人生，代价是结束后再来见他
facts.anchor: Let’s call this one a free sample

facts.fact: Fisch 以『再见 Marcela/娶她』诱惑；Wilhelm 问 price；要求 Talkies 发明后再会
facts.anchor: Talkies should be invented by then, so we won’t need these stupid title cards to speak.
